C0169.title: The AI Cheat That Frustrated FPS Players Finally Faced Legal Consequences
C0169.summary: In September 2023, police in Yujiang, Jiangxi, cracked China first case involving the production and sale of an AI-powered game cheat. The cheat used AI visual recognition to achieve rapid auto-aim and head locking, mainly targeting FPS scenarios such as Valorant and undermining competitive fairness. Tencent security teams assisted law enforcement, and the case later proceeded to public sentencing.
